messages.text: BL-1804 🎵 in progress — The sweep's own 'Work <id> active unassigned - assign_to and route it.' nudge to the coordinator counts as a dispatch trail, so dispatch_trail_cli answers DISPATCHED for a ticket nobody routed, route_backlog_to_coder.sh refuses to route it without --force, and the dispatch-gap sweep goes quiet about it (BL-1803, 2026-09-29): a note addressed to the coordinator is never a dispatch, and the nudge is deduplicated against its own unread copy
